svg.title: Stacked decorators

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Decorators wrap: the one closest to the function runs first

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: @a @b @c def f() == f = a(b(c(f))) - but at CALL time the outer layer executes first
